summary: Intake-wide solution review found an unresolved core UI defect matching the human clarification. The implementation added the requested Level 1 and Level 2 menu structure and submenu destination pages with matching source-level headings, but the submenu show/hide behavior is not reliably implemented: `src/features/dashboard/shell.tsx` relies on the HTML `hidden` attribute while `src/app/globals.css` assigns `.dashboard-nav-children { display: grid; }`, which can override hidden behavior and leave Level 2 menus visible. Non-browser checks passed (`npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, focused Node source test 4/4), but those checks did not catch the visual collapse defect. Browser/Playwright was not run in this task per restriction.

defects.description: Core acceptance is not met: clicking Feedback or Configure should display/hide Level 2 menu options, but the implementation can leave all submenus visible. Evidence: `src/features/dashboard/shell.tsx` renders `<div className="dashboard-nav-children" hidden={!isExpanded}>`, while `src/app/globals.css` sets `.dashboard-nav-children { display: grid; }`; author CSS display rules can override native hidden rendering, matching the recorded manual finding that only the arrow changes while Level 2 options remain visible.

The focused source test passed but does not verify the actual collapsed visual state or CSS-hidden interaction. Evidence: `.ai_factory/tests/unit/dashboard/dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs` asserts that `aria-expanded`, state toggling, and `.dashboard-nav-children` styles exist, but it does not assert an explicit `[hidden]` or collapsed-state CSS rule that forces submenu content out of layout when `isExpanded` is false.
